title: Provision Android 36/JDK 17 toolchain and XP5 diagnostics
description: Android Studio SDK 36/adb and JBR21 now support local builds; default Java26 still fails. Connected Sonim XP5900 (XP5plus) runs Android 11/API30. Capture raw screen-on/off knob/PTT and app-level delivery without storing private identifiers; earlier XP5 remains unverified.
acceptance_criteria: Local assembleDebug/testDebugUnitTest pass and XP5900 raw knob/PTT sequences are captured with screen on/off; identify documented app-level delivery or report a concrete blocker.
notes: Read-only XP5900 research: Sonim SPCC Service 15.4.0.6_1 is installed as a privileged system-UID app; public FirstNet SPCC page describes button APIs but is dated 2018 and predates XP5900. Device has a CSM binder service and a system SPCC service. Static inspection suggests CSM dispatches channel changes to a selected app via listener or package-targeted broadcast, potentially useful with screen off, but no app is currently selected; no app-level delivery demonstrated. General SPCC API permission is signature|privileged, so ordinary OmniTAK cannot assume access to control methods. ADB capability inventory: matrix keypad (D-pad/Enter/Back/number keys), gpio buttons (two programmable/SOS/PTT), separate knob CW/CCW/CSK, power/volume and headset PTT. Keylayouts provide Android names, not delivery proof. Earlier clockwise raw pulses screen on/off and CCW screen on remain the only event evidence; no new physical rotations were requested. Do not commit decompiled vendor code, tokens or device identifiers.
